recommendation_summary: Recommends a shared database that saves every reservation and enforces the item/date overlap rule atomically, with the spreadsheet kept only as a view. Before shipping, it should prove that two simultaneous conflicting submissions give one save and one rejection. It explicitly rejects colours and reminders as the safeguard. Unmet need: it can't confirm a this-week ship date without knowing the user's spreadsheet platform and save workflow.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The owner requires overlapping reservations for the same physical item to be rejected at save time, including simultaneous submissions.
labels.Deleted: Colours and reminders as conflict prevention.
labels.Bottleneck: Checking availability and saving must be one atomic operation shared by all six agents.
labels.Checked myself: You reported last week’s double booking; I have not inspected the spreadsheet or its capabilities.

note: The reply chooses atomic, server-enforced rejection of overlapping bookings, explicitly handles simultaneous submissions, and keeps the spreadsheet only as a view.
